name: Zotero MindFlow
shortDescription: 将文献、批注与思路组织为可编辑导图。
Organize papers, annotations, and ideas into editable maps.
introduction: 面向论文研读和知识整理，在 Zotero 内用画布与大纲组织文献材料、节点和任务，并按需使用 AI 生成研读草稿。
For paper reading and knowledge organization: arrange literature, nodes, and tasks using a canvas and outline in Zotero, with optional AI-generated reading drafts.
githubDescription: Organize papers, annotations, and ideas into editable maps. Part of Zotero Flow.
